Who’s eligible for the Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) campaign?
As Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) is a flexible product, you can redeem your funds anytime after subscription. You can redeem from either the campaign landing page or under Assets > Earn.

When the campaign ends, if you haven’t redeemed manually, we’ll automatically reinvest eligible crypto (such as USDT, OKB, and many others) into Simple Earn. Any unsupported crypto will be returned to your Funding account within 2 hours.
You’ll receive two types of rewards:
(1) an airdrop of a newly-listed token (principal-protected), and
(2) a base reward in your subscription crypto that’s generated with Simple Earn.
Simple Earn rewards begin in the second hour after your funds are lent out. If not lent out, no rewards are generated.
Airdrop rewards for newly listed tokens also begin up to 2 hours after subscription.
If you redeem your funds within one hour after subscription, you won’t earn any rewards for that hour.
Rewards are distributed hourly. Rewards from a one-hour period will be distributed in the following hour after calculations are completed.
For example, rewards for the time period of 3:00 UTC to 4:00 UTC will be sometime between 4:00 and 5:00 UTC.
How do I claim my rewards?

Real-Time APR:Accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute. Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for full information.

Bonus Tiered APR: Distributed to users’ Spot Accounts every day. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription). For more calculation details, please refer to this FAQ.
It may take up to 2 hours for newly upgraded VIP users to view the Bonus Tiered APR.
Once the Special APR is visible, users must make a new subscription (including Auto-Subscribe) to activate the promotional APR — prior subscriptions will not activate it.
Rewards are limited. Once the rewards pool is exhausted, Bonus Tiered APR will no longer be available to new participants.

During the Activity Period, users who borrow stablecoins via Binance Loans or Margin and subscribe to the promotion products for arbitrage will not be eligible for Bonus Tiered APR rewards. Any Bonus Tiered APR rewards already distributed will be deducted.
Bonus Tiered APR is offered as an additional reward on top of Real-Time APR.
Bonus Tiered APR accrual is based on a daily random snapshot of your Flexible Product balance (taken between 00:00:00 - 23:59:59 UTC).

Any redemption of Flexible Products made during the daily reward accrual window (from 00:00:00 (UTC) to 00:00:00 (UTC) of the following day) will stop the accrual of Bonus Tiered APR rewards on the redeemed amount for that day.

All users who hold open positions for USDC and USDT Flexible Products will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards during the Promotion Period. Once the Promotion ends, users will be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards only.
